name: LaTeX Toolbar
description: Adds a markItUp-based LaTeX toolbar to textareas matching a configurable jQuery selector.
project_description:
Can't remember the LaTeX code for infinity? This module may be for you!

 Back to top 

 Drupal 10 and 11 Support 
 Drupal 10 and 11 version is now available.

 Provides a basic point-and-click toolbar to auto populate textareas with the LaTeX code you specify. Simply click an image in the LaTeX toolbar and the textarea will fill with the LaTeX code you just clicked.

 Back to top 

 Drupal 7 
 This module converts HTML text and Tex to PDF via the html2ps Perl script by Jan Kärrman.

 The markItUp! JavaScript library is necessary for the LaTeX buttons which are TeX shortcuts of common math symbols.

 The mimetex CGI script by John Forkosh is required for TeX rendering.

 You may download the markitup dependency from this URL. For Drupal 9 you can use Drush.

 Dependency for all versions: http://markitup.jaysalvat.com/home 

 The module has a number a images which contribute to its total size.

 For complete instructions see documentation.
